description: This file is a mock service worker script used for intercepting and handling network requests in a testing or development environment, specifically related to the MSW (Mock Service Worker) library. It manages client registration, message handling, request interception, and response mocking.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Handles intercepted fetch requests, determines whether to mock or pass through, and communicates with the client for mock responses.

methods.name: resolveMainClient
methods.description: Resolves the main client associated with a fetch event, prioritizing active clients and visible window clients.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Generates a response for a fetch event, either by mocking or passing through based on client state.

methods.name: sendToClient
methods.description: Sends a message to a client using MessageChannel and returns a promise that resolves with the response.

methods.name: respondWithMock
methods.description: Creates a mocked Response object, marking it as a mocked response.

methods.name: serializeRequest
methods.description: Serializes a Request object into a plain object with its properties for messaging.
